places.name: Khorfakkan Beach
places.description: Long sandy public beach in a sheltered bay on the east coast, with a promenade, cafés, play areas and water sports. Shark Island lies just off the shore, a popular snorkelling spot.

places.name: Khorfakkan Amphitheatre and Waterfall
places.hours_text: Sat to Wed 09:00 to 23:00; Thu and Fri 09:00 to 01:00 (event days may differ)
places.description: Roman-style open-air amphitheatre on a hillside above the bay, next to a man-made waterfall cut into the mountain; lit up after dark. Concerts are held here in the cooler months.

places.name: Al Suhub Rest House
places.description: Flying-saucer-shaped viewpoint about 600 m above sea level, the highest public lookout in Khor Fakkan, with a restaurant, a playground and 360-degree views of the bay and the Hajar Mountains. Reached by a winding mountain road or a 3 km trail from Al Rafisah Dam.

places.name: Al Rafisah Dam
places.description: Mountain reservoir on the Sharjah–Khor Fakkan road with a palm-shaded lakeside promenade, boat and kayak hire, a playground, a restaurant and a marked hiking trail up to Al Suhub Rest House.

places.name: Shees Park
places.description: Family park in Wadi Shees, tucked between the Hajar Mountains, with a man-made waterfall, shaded picnic and barbecue areas, a playground and a viewing terrace.

places.name: Najd Al Maqsar Heritage Village
places.description: Restored mountain village of 13 stone-and-mud houses more than a century old, watched over by a 300-year-old tower on the hilltop above.

places.name: Al Rabi Tower and Hiking Trail
places.description: Watchtower from 1915 on a hill above the town and the start of a well-marked mountain trail to a 395 m summit with wide views over the bay. Bring water; there is no shade on the way.

places.name: Resistance Monument
places.description: Helmet-shaped hilltop monument and small museum near Khorfakkan Square, telling the story of the town's resistance to the Portuguese invasion of 1507 through a film and artefacts, with a view over the city.

events.title: Tigers Obstacle Race Khorfakkan 2027
events.description: Obstacle race starting from Khorfakkan Amphitheatre, with categories for children, amateurs and professionals and a sports festival alongside. Organised by the Sharjah Government Media Bureau.
